description: WireGuard between two endpoints in this repository, userspace device (system=false, no TUN, no root). The tunnel address is a synthetic /32 pair; the server side rewrites the destination back to the lab target so the cell measures the encrypted tunnel rather than a plain loopback.

extra.known_limits: userspace endpoint: download and UDP do not carry traffic reliably in this configuration; see docs/perf/FAILURES.md#b7
